Java standard library only (Java SE). No external frameworks or libraries. Use built-in packages like java.net, java.io, java.util for core functionality.
Directory for Java source files organized by package structure. Main class with entry point (main method). Directory for utility classes. One class per function group. Directory for static resources (HTML, CSS, configuration files).
Write clean, modular, and well-structured Java code following standard conventions. Use small, focused methods and classes. Separate concerns logically (e.g., models, services, utilities). Follow object-oriented principles and use appropriate design patterns where necessary. Minimize output. Do not invent or assume specifications unless they are functionally necessary or explicitly requested.
Only in case of commands to execute, like javac or java, create a file called build.sh and write here the commands. Use "echo" in each step in order to show the progress of the script. Never write a pom.xml or build.gradle unless it is explicitly requested.
